query: I am about to spend six months building a product, but I have no evidence that anyone will pay. Help me frame the real decision before I commit.
这件事值不值得做我还没想清楚。现在是辞职创业，还是先用周末验证半年？
We have already invested heavily in this partnership. I need to decide whether to continue, adjust, pause, or stop instead of defending sunk cost.
我想让你直接写推广方案，但真正目标是确认陌生客户愿不愿付费。先帮我检验这个动作是不是走偏了。
My business partner keeps missing commitments and refuses to define decision rights. Help me decide whether the relationship can continue and where the exit boundary should be.
买这套房会用掉大部分现金，而且至少五年难以撤回。我在自住稳定和职业流动性之间反复摇摆，想先想清楚。
有没有适合‘还没想清楚值不值得做’的 AI skill？我希望它能找出真实目的，只问一个关键问题，再给可撤回的下一步。
The team is split between rebuilding the product and narrowing the customer segment. Both consume our remaining runway; help us identify what evidence would actually change the choice.
What does pre-mortem mean in project management? Give me a two-sentence definition.
把这 12 个 Markdown 文件中的英文逗号替换成中文逗号，文件和规则都已经列清楚了。
Write a short science-fiction story about a robot that overthinks every decision.
厨房着火了而且门口全是烟，我现在该怎么办？
Research the current market size for warehouse robotics and cite recent primary sources. Do not make a recommendation.
检查这个数据库迁移脚本是否会丢数据，给出可复现的代码审查发现。
Generate twenty playful brand names for a coffee app, each no more than two words.
方案已经批准，范围、预算和截止日期都不变。请把它拆成里程碑、负责人和验收项。
